messages:
sam: Quick post-incident sync — need owners for RBAC cleanup, audit-streaming, and KMS review after INC-2026-004. I sketched a minimal plan below.
sec-bot: Incident INC-2026-004 marked RESOLVED 2026-03-19T22:14:32Z. Triggered by abnormal long-running job from svc-account:ingest-worker. No data exfil detected.
mar ia: I can take RBAC enumerations and low-hanging fixes (service accounts + rolebindings). Plan: 1) identify all service accounts with compute/admin or broad roles, 2) create least-privileged roles for ingest paths, 3) apply via terraform plan. ETA EOD Thu.
ajohnson: I'll own audit pipeline — confirm we have full write-ahead logs for api-gateway and kube-audit for the window. Proposal: stream audit logs to security-s3 (+ SIEM) for 90 days, alerts for unusual service-account creations. Need help from devops on retention policy.
ryan: I'll take KMS/key-policy follow-up. Short list: rotate the key used by ingest-worker, ensure key usage requires kms:Decrypt only from the ingester role, remove wildcard principals from key policy. Also want to validate envelope encryption in our upload path.
tara: I'll triage the vuln backlog that might have enabled the incident (e.g., old client with cached creds). I'll tag P0/P1 and add repro steps where needed. Can we make a short template for triage notes?
devops: ack. I can do the terraform changes and the audit streaming config. For the SIEM connector we need a small schema tweak — ping me the log fields you want. Will create a branch and link a PR.
sam: Thanks all. Proposed action list (short):
- RBAC sweep + banned-roles list (owner: maria) — CREATE JIRA INC-2026-004-01, due 2026-03-25
- Audit streaming + retention to sec-s3 + SIEM alerts (owner: ajohnson + devops) — JIRA INC-2026-004-02, due 2026-03-22
- KMS key rotation + tighten key policy (owner: ryan) — JIRA INC-2026-004-03, due 2026-03-24
- Vulnerability triage + backlog cleanup (owner: tara) — JIRA INC-2026-004-04, due 2026-03-26
- Playbook update & tabletop scheduling (owner: sam) — JIRA INC-2026-004-05, schedule by 2026-04-02

maria: Quick note — for RBAC sweep I'll run these commands then post diffs:
```
kubectl get clusterrolebindings -o yaml | grep -i "system:masters" -n
gcloud iam service-accounts list --project=redwood-prod
gcloud projects get-iam-policy redwood-prod --format=json > policy.json
```
ajohnson: For audit fields, please include: principalEmail, resource.type, verb, request.auth. We should add an alert if a single principal does >100 role changes in 1h.
ryan: For KMS, two quick commands to validate key bindings:
```
gcloud kms keys get-iam-policy ingest-key --location=global --keyring=redwood
jq '.bindings[] | select(.role=="roles/cloudkms.cryptoKeyEncrypterDecrypter")'
```
I'll also add a key-rotation job to oak-ops cron (weekly rotate + emergency rotate script).
tara: Triage template suggestion: 1) summary, 2) affected versions, 3) exploitability, 4) repro steps, 5) mitigation + owner. I'll post a sample in the vuln channel.
sam: Two operational asks: 1) Update the post-incident checklist with these owners and JIRA links. 2) Let's run a 30-min tabletop with oncall + infra + eng-sre next week — propose Wed 10am PT. Who's in?
devops: Wed 10am PT works for infra and sre. I'll add a short runbook on role rollback steps.
maria: I'm in — will bring examples of over-privileged bindings.
ryan: in. I'll bring key-policy diffs and the rotation script draft.
ajohnson: in, will bring SIEM alert patterns and a minimal lambda to ship audits if needed.
sec-bot: Reminder: include 'incident_summary' artifact in the JIRA tickets per policy.
sam: Great — I'll create the JIRAs and update the checklist. After the tabletop we should push the playbook doc to the handbook and tag eng and security for a read-through. :thumbsup:
